name: @bongtu/prover-cli
description: bongtu prover-cli — pure prover: a resolved ProvingRequest (complete circom witness input) -> Groth16 solidity calldata {a,b,c,pub}. CPU (snarkjs) for deposit/transfer/withdraw, GPU (rabbitsnark) for 1x256 disburse. No CSV / addr-resolve / membership-build / tx (SPEC §6).
